mapper.select: SELECT CA.JOB_CODE , (SELECT J.JOB_NAME FROM JOB J WHERE J.JOB_CODE = CA.JOB_CODE) AS JOB_CODE_NAME , CA.CAREER_YEAR , (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM CMN_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_DETAIL_NO = CA.CAREER_YEAR) AS CAREER_YEAR_NAME , CA.JOB_GRADE_CODE , (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM CMN_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_DETAIL_NO = CA.JOB_GRADE_CODE) AS JOB_GRADE_CODE_NAME , CA.POSITION_CODE , (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM CMN_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_DETAIL_NO = CA.POSITION_CODE) AS POSITION_CODE_NAME , CA.COM_ID , (SELECT COM_NAME FROM COMPANY WHERE USER_ID = CA.COM_ID) AS COM_NAME FROM CAREER CA WHERE CA.RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}
SELECT MY_SKILL_NAME FROM MY_SKILL WHERE RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}

SELECT LANGUAGE_EXAM_CODE , (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM CMN_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_DETAIL_NO = LANGUAGE_EXAM_CODE) AS LANGUAGE_EXAM_CODE_NAME , LANGUAGE_EXAM_NAME , LANGUAGE_EXAM_SCORE , LANGUAGE_EXAM_LEVEL_CODE , (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM CMN_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_DETAIL_NO = LANGUAGE_EXAM_LEVEL_CODE) AS LANGUAGE_EXAM_LEVEL_CODE_NAME FROM LANGUAGE_SKILL WHERE RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}

SELECT HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE , (SELECT C.CODE_NAME FROM CMN_CODE C WHERE C.CODE_DETAIL_NO = HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE) AS HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE_NAME , SCHOOL_NAME , DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM EDUCATION WHERE RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo} ORDER BY HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT MAIN_MAJOR, SUB_MAJOR FROM SPECIALTY WHERE RESUME_NO = #{resumeNo}

SELECT DISTINCT LICENSE_CODE FROM MEMBER M LEFT OUTER JOIN RESUME R ON R.RESUME_NO = M.RESUME_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN MY_LICENSE L ON L.RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO WHERE M.RESUME_NO IS NOT NULL AND L.LICENSE_CODE IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(MY_SKILL_NAME) FROM MEMBER M LEFT OUTER JOIN RESUME R ON R.RESUME_NO = M.RESUME_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN MY_SKILL S ON S.RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO WHERE M.RESUME_NO IS NOT NULL AND S.MY_SKILL_NAME IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MEMBER M LEFT OUTER JOIN RESUME R ON R.RESUME_NO = M.RESUME_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN EDUCATION E ON E.RESUME_NO = R.RESUME_NO WHERE M.RESUME_NO IS NOT NULL AND E.DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NOT NULL
